newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: GEC to reveal UAE offset projects this week.
newsitem.headline: GEC to reveal UAE offset projects this week.

text.p: Britain's GEC Marconi will this week announce up to three offset projects in the United Arab Emirates during an international arms show in Abu Dhabi, an industry executive said on Sunday.
Under the UAE's offset programme, the country requires its arms suppliers to invest in projects in the Gulf Arab state.
"GEC will announce the projects during IDEX this week," said the source, who requested anonymity. IDEX, which began on Sunday and lasts five days, is one of the biggest arms shows in the world.
The executive said the ventures would involve a high-tech project, a maritime project related to shipping and a manufacturing project.

He said the ventures would "make a significant contribution to the UAE economy", but would not say if they were related to past or future deals with the UAE, an oil-rich Gulf Arab state that has emerged as an important player in the international arms industry.
GEC, the defence firm of Britain's General Electric Co, has long-standing ties with Abu Dhabi.
International arms manufacturers supplying the UAE are required to invest a portion of a deal's worth in profitable ventures with a UAE partner under the terms of the offset scheme.
Some Western firms have said the programme's conditions are too stringent and have complained of a lack of investment opportunities in the country.
